column1: # Hand-maintained values for scripts/build_vehicle_catalogue.py. Blank = use the builder's default.
# msrp_2024: approximate base price of the model in 2024 dollars (ASSUMED; scales repair and total-loss costs).
# theft_factor: whole-vehicle theft relative to an average car (ASSUMED; shaped on HLDI/NICB theft rankings).
# used only for models the Chicago crash records do not name.
# segment / body_type / vehicle_class: override the builder's classification (EPA files some crossovers as cars).
